name: Collection Colors
description: Color collection icons and labels in the sidebar. One install, applies to every collection.
instructions: Set where collection colors appear in the sidebar and breadcrumbs. Sidebar targets: collection title icon, collection title, page icon, and page — use the tint toggles to offset hues per target. Highlighted applies the same text and icon treatment when a row is keyboard-focused or is the page open in the panel (including the collection title icon when the sidebar is collapsed): None leaves Thymer's colors, Auto picks readable contrast, Tint shifts to another Tailwind shade (50–950) with optional invert for the other theme. Click a collection to pick its color; per-collection overrides sit below the picker.
author: @akaready
